parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Software never chooses a drone or a way for us because it is the dispatcher's legal responsibility, but we do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. Each drone has a home site, and each company has its own charging pads at its own sites, which are never lent to another company.
